title: I Talked With Another Person In MW
content: Last night I was in MW shopping for a piece of jewelry. In one of the walkways a person stopped me and asked what this place was. I actually told her it was Mall World, a place where people come in their dreams, she said she had been coming here since she was a child. This is the first time I have "known" that I was in MW. I never found what I was lookong for.
